alert.message: Health check found service degradation: PM2 process whisper is stopped, Docker containers langfuse_langfuse-web_1 is restarting, lidaros-frontend-1 and omiximo-email-automation are unhealthy, and OpenClaw gateway service state is inactive/non-standard despite local RPC probe responding.
alert.action: Investigate whisper PM2 process, inspect failing/unhealthy containers, and repair or reinstall OpenClaw gateway service configuration (recommended: openclaw doctor / openclaw gateway install --force).
